runs.implementation: Python standard library; frozen r1903 JSON input
runs.reported_design: Caps every historical paired UCB at zero, checks identical gates for tau in {0,0.02,0.04,0.10}, and evaluates a two-model strict-dominance boundary.
runs.reported_outputs: No scientific experiment; deterministic certificate-repair audit only.
runs.scientific_scope: Verifies the algebraic repair and the tau>=0 gate invariance of the stored frontier; it does not replay training or establish coverage.
provenance_gaps: frozen source values remain snapshot artifacts

runs.reported_design: Four public classification carriers; candidate pool of four classifiers; matched seeds 0..4; constructed subgroup-mixture grid.
runs.reported_outputs: Exact MPB 0.260, exact Hoeffding 0.097, normal 0.503 committed rate at tau=0.04; committed coverage reported 1.000.
runs.scientific_scope: Historical certificate frontier on constructed class-mixture shifts. It is snapshot-reported only, not natural temporal/geographic shift validation and not a demonstration that the finite-sample application contract held.

runs.reported_design: Oracle-stratified count comparison over already true-class-separated arrays on four public carriers; documentation reports three seeds.
runs.reported_outputs: Commit-rate and coverage comparisons including capacity-wall outcomes.
runs.scientific_scope: Oracle-stratified constructed mixture-grid diagnostic only; it is not deployable label acquisition or allocation-policy evidence.

runs.reported_design: Joint convex solution for a beta/sqrt(n) allocation objective with active-engine diagnostics.
runs.reported_outputs: Corrected dual/active-set diagnostics and carrier allocation tables.
runs.scientific_scope: Oracle-stratified width-surrogate objective, not established actual candidate/mix regret-UCB optimization, label acquisition, or allocation policy.

runs.reported_design: Controlled synthetic family varying spanning and variance conditions.
runs.reported_outputs: Mechanism-level signed-area comparison for allocation gate branches.
runs.scientific_scope: Synthetic mechanism evidence; cannot establish deployment invariance or real-shift effectiveness.

runs.reported_design: Fresh seeds 10..14 and stored finite budget-grid rows with CAL subsampling and data-derived selection as documented by the snapshot.
runs.reported_outputs: Snapshot-reported zero genuine exact-relative switches on the inspected grid and exact-absolute-gate diagnostics.
runs.scientific_scope: The stored grid is a data-specific diagnostic. Separately, a Hoeffding required-width calculation may hold empirical paired means, F0, i-star, and Delta fixed while varying only widths; it is not a claim about fresh sampled or reselected allocations.
provenance_gaps: no uniform result over changed empirical means or selectors

runs.reported_design: Fresh seeds 10..14, stored total-budget grid, static oracle allocation rules, and exact relative/absolute diagnostics.

runs.scientific_scope: Fresh-seed oracle-stratified internal finite-grid diagnostic, not external deployment or label-acquisition evidence and not an extension of the fixed-statistic M9 calculation.
